title: Peak pelvis flexion rotation at full forward flexion

quantity.name: range of flexion
quantity.definition: S1 sensor rotation vs global at full voluntary flexion

source.authors: Tafazzol A, Arjmand N, Shirazi-Adl A, Parnianpour M

measurement.device: Xsens MTx inertial/magnetic sensors on spinous processes of T5, L1, S1
measurement.task: slow self-paced maximal forward flexion from upright and return to upright, 3 trials, no load, sagittal plane

protocol.notes: Table 1 also lists per-subject values; time to full flexion 5.2 (SD 0.7) s.
protocol.summary: Peak voluntary forward flexion rotations from upright standing, 8 young males, IMU (Table 1).
how_to_use: Use 53.0 deg (SD 5.2) as the pelvis contribution at full voluntary trunk flexion (trunk T5 = 121 deg).
At full flexion the trunk decomposes as pelvis 53.0 + lumbar 60.2 + T5-L1 8.3 deg (sum 121.5 vs 121 measured).
For intermediate angles use the L/P tables (kinematics.tafazzol2014.lp_ratio_flexion / lp_ratio_return).

extraction.check_notes: Rechecked against Table 1 mean (SD) row and abstract.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
